title: Academic Excellence Awards: Celebrating Merit, Building Futures
excerpt: Megh Foundation honored H.S.C. and S.S.C. achievers and paired recognition with career guidance, motivation, and mentorship.
coverImageAlt: Students receiving awards and certificates at academic excellence event
bodyMarkdown:
## Recognition with purpose

At Jyotiba Fule Library, Kalol, Megh Foundation hosted its annual Awards and Motivation Program to recognize students scoring 70% and above in H.S.C. and S.S.C. examinations. Each award celebrated discipline, consistency, and ambition.

## What made this meaningful

Beyond trophies and certificates, the event included structured career guidance, motivational talks, and direct student interaction with mentors.

- Career counseling on pathways after school
- Motivational talks from professionals and alumni
- Interactive Q&A on real student concerns

## Why this matters

Recognition creates confidence. Guidance creates direction. Together, they help first-generation learners and rural youth make better decisions for higher education and employment.

## Looking ahead

Megh Foundation will continue this model of combining academic recognition with practical planning so student achievement translates into long-term opportunity.
